narrative.headline: Defensive rotation dominates: staples, healthcare, and financial infrastructure attract concentrated bullish flow while cyclicals and mega-cap pharma bleed premium on the bearish side.
bullish_themes: Consumer Staples leadership with premium-weighted conviction across discount retail (WMT $4.0M, TGT), beverages (KO $3.1M, CELH), and household products (ELF, KMB)
Healthcare bifurcation — bullish flow concentrated in devices and health data (TEM $4.2M with 43 ask-side prints, ABT, GEHC) while large-cap pharma (JNJ, AMGN, VRTX) sees heavy bearish premium
Financial infrastructure over banks — exchanges and data names (ICE, SPGI, FDS) plus asset managers (BLK $2.3M, BX) attract flow, while insurance is split (AFL/ALL bullish, PGR fully bearish)
Aerospace & Defense accumulation via TDG ($1.5M) and AVAV ($6.8M) with SPCX carrying an outlier $40M premium print
notable_individual_flows: TEM — $4.2M premium with 43 ask-side bullish prints, the highest-conviction single-name signal in the scan
WMT — $4.0M premium, 100% bullish, 14 ask-side prints anchoring the staples theme
SPCX — $40M premium in Aerospace & Defense stands out as a size outlier worth verifying
PGR — 100% bearish flow on $1.7M premium contradicts the otherwise bullish P&C insurance read (AFL, ALL, TRV)
COIN — $5.4M premium at 69% bearish is the loudest bearish tape in the scan
narrative.absences: No bullish flow surfaced in Technology despite XLK-adjacent industries being scannable — semis, software, and hardware are entirely absent from the bullish list. Energy (XLE) and Communication Services (XLC) also show zero conviction names.
